note: BH-8328: a fix-round park (review-changes-requested) is never closed when 0 fix rounds were counted on its head since the last head reset, or when its newest attempt is a fix round that found nothing to brief. Each refusal re-offers the park, and the next fix round re-reads the head's lead review. After this many refusals on one head, the next refusal sends ONE NEEDS_HUMAN lane alert (id br-zero-rung:<project>:<cap-key>:<head12>), and the PR still stays open. 0 = alert on the first refusal.
